### Jackson Announces New Annuity Offering for AARP Members


11/02/2026


*Program advances Jackson’s growth and diversification strategy,* *increases access to annuities*


LANSING, Mich.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


[Jackson National Life Insurance Company](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.jackson.com%2F&esheet=54632103&newsitemid=20261102247231&lan=en-US&anchor=Jackson+National+Life+Insurance+Company&index=1&md5=2558aa42373fe0557f09e63406da4f54) ® (Jackson®), the main operating subsidiary of Jackson Financial Inc.i (NYSE: JXN), today announced a new annuity program – AARP® Annuity Program from Jackson, an exclusive offering created for AARP members. Through the program, AARP members will have access to a distinct set of Jackson annuities and educational resources designed to help support financial security and retirement confidence. The initial launch of the program is expected on November 16, 2026, in 10 states, with broader availability targeted during the first half of 2027. The program advances Jackson’s growth and diversification strategy and expands consumer access to annuities.


“This program reflects Jackson’s continued focus on growth, diversification and meeting consumers where they are in their retirement planning process,” said Alison Reed, EVP, Head of Distribution, Jackson National Life Distributors LLC (JNLD), the marketing and distribution business of Jackson. “By providing AARP members access to the program, we have an opportunity to expand access to Jackson’s annuity products to consumers who are not yet working with a financial professional, helping more Americans prepare for a financially secure future.”


“The addition of Jackson’s annuity products as an AARP member benefit advances AARP’s goal to empower people to choose how they live as they age. Financial security and stability are main concerns for most AARP members as they plan for retirement. The new AARP Annuity Program from Jackson provides a program to help AARP members meet their financial needs in retirement. We are pleased that Jackson is able to offer AARP members an annuity program,” said Jeff Gaboury, Senior Vice President of Financial Products, AARP Services.


Additional details about the AARP Annuity Program from Jackson, including product availability, member resources and application information, will be announced at the time of the launch. Jackson will offer its products and services available through the AARP Annuity Program from Jackson to AARP members, provided that all applicable state regulations and product requirements are met.


**ABOUT JACKSON**


Jackson® (NYSE: JXN) is committed to helping clarify the complexity of retirement planning—for financial professionals and their clients. Through our range of annuity products, financial know-how, history of award-winning service* and streamlined experiences, we strive to reduce the confusion that complicates retirement planning. We take a balanced, long-term approach to responsibly serving all our stakeholders, including customers, shareholders, distribution partners, employees, regulators and community partners. We believe by providing clarity for all today, we can help drive better outcomes for tomorrow. For more information, visit[www.jackson.com.](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.jackson.com%2F&esheet=54632103&newsitemid=20261102247231&lan=en-US&anchor=www.jackson.com.&index=2&md5=5d9083f28fa70c0805ccad3198736db1)

Jackson® is the marketing name for Jackson Financial Inc., Jackson National Life Insurance Company® (Home Office: Lansing, Michigan) and Jackson National Life Insurance Company of New York® (Home Office: Purchase, New York).


**ABOUT AARP**


AARP is the nation’s largest nonprofit, nonpartisan organization dedicated to empowering people 50 and older to choose how they live as they age. With a nationwide presence, AARP strengthens communities and advocates for what matters most to the 125 million Americans 50-plus and their families: health and financial security, and personal fulfillment. AARP also works for individuals in the marketplace by sparking new solutions and allowing carefully chosen, high-quality products and services to carry the AARP name. As a trusted source for news and information, AARP produces the nation’s largest-circulation publications: AARP The Magazine and the AARP Bulletin. To learn more, visit[aarp.org](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.aarp.org%2Fabout-aarp%2F&esheet=54632103&newsitemid=20261102247231&lan=en-US&anchor=aarp.org&index=3&md5=f484f17602bfc350c9eee1dffeb046e6) ,[aarp.org/espanol](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.aarp.org%2Fespanol%2Fconoce-aarp%2F&esheet=54632103&newsitemid=20261102247231&lan=en-US&anchor=aarp.org%2Fespanol&index=4&md5=b8c1072d12402428b988478b53b1dd68) or follow @AARP, @AARPLatino and @AARPadvocates on social media.


**ABOUT AARP SERVICES**


AARP Services, founded in 1999, is a wholly-owned taxable subsidiary of AARP. AARP Services manages the provider relationships for and performs quality control oversight of the wide range of products and services that carry the AARP name and are made available by independent providers as benefits to AARP’s millions of members. The provider offers currently span health products, financial products, travel and leisure products, and life event services. Specific products include Medicare supplemental insurance; credit cards, auto and home, mobile home and motorcycle insurance, life insurance and annuities; member discounts on rental cars, cruises, vacation packages and lodging; special offers on technology and gifts; pharmacy services and legal services. AARP Services also engages in new product development activities for AARP and provides certain consulting services to outside companies.
